correctness.rationale: The graph, all sixteen vertex-edge arrows and exact acyclic face predicate are defined. A fresh standalone Python3 verifier exhausts 575 nonempty faces, their 1808 Hasse incidences, and a 255-pair matching; a complete directed topological sort certifies acyclicity and the critical cells (one dimension zero, 64 dimension three). Character calculations check 32 signed fixed-simplex chain traces and all eight D4 automorphisms; Lefschetz gives character values 64,0,...,0; rational character theory yields precisely eight regular summands. Five exact small-field boundary rank checks independently agree but are not used as proof of integral acyclicity.

value.rationale: The dihedral action is the full natural symmetry of the smallest wheel with a nontrivial 64-dimensional Morse-complex homology. The complete regular-character decomposition is a natural equivariant invariant not implied by Betti numbers or the automorphism group. It determines all rational isotypic multiplicities, the eight-dimensional invariant subspace, and vanishing traces for rotations and reflections, providing a concrete symmetry benchmark for further equivariant graph-Morse topology. The result is structural representation data, not a routine restatement of the already known sphere count.
